site.name: Bankers Tunnel
overview: Bankers Tunnel is a named historic mine tunnel in Imogene Basin in Ouray County's Sneffels mining district. USGS-derived topographic records preserve the tunnel as a distinct mapped mining feature on the Ironton quadrangle at approximately 37.95722, -107.71867.
moreHistory: The retained evidence securely supports the Bankers Tunnel name, its Imogene Basin identity, and its mapped tunnel locality. A focused review did not establish a reliable tunnel-specific operating chronology, ownership history, production record, or documented surviving portal condition, so those details are left unstated rather than inferred from nearby mines with similar names.
